title: 能力条从满降到很低 → 旧录音 → 工具 → 重建声音，声波灰变紫

complete_video_analysis.limitations: Automatic scene boundaries and wording may be approximate; source code and visual tests are separate.

scenes.audio: Because of a disease called Spinal Muscular Atrophy, it has become very difficult for her to speak.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: Static camera angle showing a legislative chamber with dark wood furniture and green surfaces. In the background, a person in judicial robes sits at a desk with two laptops. In the foreground, an older man with grey hair is seen from behind. The right half of the frame is a white graphic overlay. Lighting is artificial and overhead. Color grading is natural with desaturated tones.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A clean, white background with a minimalist logo centered in the frame. The logo is black text within a rounded rectangular border. No movement or character present. Bright, even studio lighting.

scenes.audio: Reconstructed her voice from her previous recordings.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A white digital workspace background. Graphic elements appear representing a workflow: a document icon on the left connected by an arrow to the central software logo, followed by another arrow leading to a purple soundwave visualization on the right. Static camera, flat design aesthetic.

scenes.audio: Completed the speech in parliament. The words were written by her, and the voice was her own.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A white screen featuring two rounded rectangular boxes with checkmark icons. The boxes animate in sequence from top to bottom. The color palette is white, black, and soft purple. No human subjects present.

scenes.audio: My Lords, I welcome this bill.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A woman in her 60s or 70s with fair skin and short blonde hair sits in a high-tech motorized wheelchair. She is wearing a black top, a white neck garment, and a clear medical oxygen mask over her nose. Beside her stands a middle-aged man with short grey-brown hair, wearing a dark blue suit and white shirt, leaning in to assist her. They are in a grand hall with red leather seating and dark wood paneling. The lighting is bright and overhead.
